title: Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Pine is an agency building fitness apps. We are looking for a mid-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Eastmere.

Our stack: kotlin, swift, csharp. You will work closely with design and product, improve app performance and stability and review code with the team.

Four-day weeks in summer.
